statement.p: Consider each of the following near-atomic scenarios/processes. Count the total number of possible outcomes for each. As a reminder, atomic processes cannot be decomposed into smaller, sub-processes and a near-atomic process is a process where only one action is ultimately taken out of a slate of possible actions (each of which is an atomic process on its own).

ol.li: When choosing a cupcake, cookie, or brownie from a bakery that sells \displaystyle{11} flavors of cupcake, \displaystyle{3} types of cookie, and \displaystyle{6} types of brownie, there are total outcomes possible.
When drawing a random card from a set of \displaystyle{11} cards or rolling a fair, six-sided die, there are total outcomes possible.
